Email

The Email view displays the complete details of an email that has been sent from your business.

This view provides a comprehensive look at all the information associated with a sent email, including its content and metadata.

Email Information

The email view shows essential details at the top of the page:

• From - The sender's email address used to send this email

• To - The recipient's email address

• Date - When the email was sent, displayed in your local time zone

• Subject - The email subject line, displayed as the main heading

Email Content

The body of the email is displayed below the header information, showing exactly what was sent to the recipient.

If the email contains formatted content or embedded documents, you can click any View buttons within the email to expand and see the full content.

Attachments

Any files attached to the email are listed at the bottom of the view.

Click on any attachment name to download or view the attached file.

The paperclip icon indicates that this email contains one or more attachments.

To see all sent emails, go to: Emails
